rooms.name: Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc:
This is Aralius's new zone.
Map and/or Descrip goes here.
Dont forget to REDIT SAVE 47, MEDIT SAVE 47, etc. when done editing.

rooms.name: Entrance to Sulfur Fur Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the base of a tall, rocky mountain.  A winding trail
leads northward, up the slope, into the mountains beyond.  Around you,
thin, brown grasses sway in waves, driven by a sulfurous wind which seems
to come from the mountains.

rooms.name: Dense Underbrush
rooms.desc:
You are being torn apart by wild roses and thorns.  All around you, wild
vines and foul-smelling flowers curl and wind their way around the pines
and rocks.  You cannot travel any further to the south or west, so thick
are the trees and growth.  The brush to the north and east seems to offer
some relief from the tearing vines.

rooms.name: Thick Forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing among tall pines.  Firs and hemlocks tower silently
above you, blocking out both the wind and the snow that may be above
the branches.  On the ground, you see sulfur-yellow moss on some of
the rocks nearby while on the trees themselves, pale green patches of
lichens add contrast to the dark terrain.  Forest surrounds you on all
sides, but proves impenetrable to the south where tall rocks intermingle
with the trees.

rooms.name: A Mossy Cliff
rooms.desc:
You stand in a forest surrounded on two sides by tall cliff walls.  Pale
yellow moss hangs like sulfurous fur off the sheets of vertical rock
which impede your progress to the east and south.  To the north, the
pine forest continues, while to the west, underbrush and rocks clutter
the space between the trunks of the firs around you.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a closed canyon.  At one point in the past, this
place obviously had a ceiling, but much of it appears to have collapsed
into the stalagmites around you.  Above you, you can see the dark smoke
and ash which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.
To the north and east, this strange cavern of debris continues, while
to the west, the cavern wall blocks your progress with impassable rock
formations.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a closed canyon.  At one point in the past, this
place obviously had a ceiling, but much of it appears to have collapsed
into the stalagmites around you.  Above you, you can see the dark smoke
and ash which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.
To the north and west, this strange cavern of debris continues, while
through a crack in the cavern wall to the east, you can see an ash-
covered valley floor.

rooms.name: A Smoldering Valley
rooms.desc:
Ash covers the moist gound here.  All around you, the haze and smoke of
recent volcanic activity make you cover your mouth to breathe. To the north
and east, the valley floor continues, while to the west, a break in the
canyon wall seems to lead to some sort of open cavern.  To the south, 
a massive cliff wall extends sharply out of the ground.  Bits of patchy
yellow moss cling to its surface.

rooms.name: A Glacial Pocket
rooms.desc:
You are standing on firm ground, surrounded by walls of hardened lava.  It
appears as though a massive glacier was here at one time, giving its life
to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far
to the northeast.  To the north and east, boulders left by the former
glacier litter the terrain, while to the west, ash and smoke follow the
air currents inthe valley.  The south boasts only a cliff of basalt and
obsidian.

rooms.name: A Glacial Pocket
rooms.desc:
You are standing on firm ground, surrounded by walls of hardened lava.  It
appears as though a massive glacier was here at one time, giving its life
to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far
to the northeast.  To the north, east, and west, boulders left by the
former glacier litter the terrain, while to the south, an enormous cliff
of basalt shelters you from the volcanic winds,

rooms.name: A Glacial Pocket
rooms.desc:
You are standing on firm ground, surrounded by walls of hardened lava.  It
appears as though a massive glacier was here at one time, giving its life
to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far
to the north.  To the north and west, boulders left by the former glacier
litter the terrain, as they do here, all around you.  To the south and
east, enormous cliffs of basalt protect you from the volcanic winds.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the slope of a mountain.  To the north, the path
you are resting on splits, separating into a trail leading north into
higher mountains and west, around a glacier on the slope.  To the south,
the mountain trail descends to the lowlands while on either side of you,
high cliffs of ice and snow impede your progress to the east and west.

rooms.name: Underbrush
rooms.desc:
You are standing in thick, dense scrub.  Woodland vines and rocks make
walking treacherous here as twigs and stumps rise from the yellow moss
on the ground.

rooms.name: A Forest Trench
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small depression in the forest.  Tall evergreens
and rocks surround you as the scent of sulfur and decay mixes with the
pines to make you dizzy.

rooms.name: A Forest Trench
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small depression in the forest.  Tall evergreens
and yellowish rocks surround you.  To the east, a tall mountain wall 
rises, impeding your progress in that direction while the forest continues
to the north and south.  To the west, the trench continues.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a closed canyon.  At one point in the past, this
place obviously had a ceiling, but much of it appears to have collapsed
into the stalagmites around you.  Above you, you can see the dark smoke
which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.  To the
north, south, and east, this cavern continues, while to the west, the
cavern wall blocks your progress with impassable rock formations.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a closed canyon.  At one point in the past, this
place obviously had a ceiling, but it appears to have collapsed into
the stalagmites around you.  Above you, you can see the dark smoke
and ash which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.
To the north, south, and west, this cavern continues, while to the
east, a lichen-covered caven wall blocks your path.

rooms.name: A Smoldering Valley
rooms.desc:
Ash and patches of yellow moss cover the moist gound here.  All around you,
the haze and smoke of recent volcanic activity make you cover your mouth
to breathe.  To the north and south, the valley floor continues, while to
the east and west, cliffs of basalt and hardened lava impede your travel.

rooms.name: A Glacial Pocket
rooms.desc:
You are standing on firm ground, surrounded by walls of hardened lava.  It
appears as though a massive glacier was here at one time, giving its life
to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far
to the northeast.  To the south and east, boulders left by the former
glacier litter the terrain, as they do here, all around you.  To the north
and west, solid walls of hardened lava rise against you.

rooms.name: A Glacial Pocket
rooms.desc:
You are standing on firm ground, surrounded by walls of hardened lava.  It
appears as though a massive glacier was here at one time, giving its life
to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far
to the northeast.  To the south, east, and west, boulders left by the
former glacier litter the terrain, as they do here and all around you.
To the north, a wall of hardened lava forms upward from the ground.

rooms.name: A Glacial Pocket
rooms.desc:
You are standing on firm ground, surrounded by walls of hardened lava.  It
appears as though a massive glacier was here at one time, giving its life
to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far
to the north.  To the south and west, boulders left by the former glacier
litter the terrain, as they do here, all around you.  To the north and
east, enormous cliffs of basalt protect you from the volcanic winds.

rooms.name: A Mountain Fork
rooms.desc:
Here, three mountain trails converge on a snowy plateau.  To your north,
the trail continues, flanked on both the eastern and western sides by 
tall faces of rock.  To your east, the trail descends down a slope into
a pine forest, while behind you, the trail leads down into the lowlands.
You can smell ozone, as if there was a recent lightning storm.

rooms.name: Entry to Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the base of an enormous pine forest.  Evergreens and
hemlocks stand silently, offering their subtle, woodsy scent to the crisp,
cold air.  Scattered here and there across the ground, a yellow, almost
furry moss grows in heaps on rocks emitting the faint scent of rotten eggs.
To the north and east, this forest continues while to the west, a tril
leads up the slope.  To the south, a few rocks and underbrush slow and
eventually impede your progress.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, thick pine
branches intertwine to block out much of the mountain sunlight and cast
the forest floor into shadow.  The forest surrounds you on all sides, 
though a trench appears to the south, disrupting the smooth terrain.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing amidst a grove of thick pines and shrubs.  Scurrying
animals and birds rustle fallen cones and leaves here, searching for 
grubs and other edibles.  To your north, south, and west, the forest
continues, while to the east, a massive mountain wall extends abruptly
from the forest floor.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a closed canyon.  At one point in the past, this
place obviously had a ceiling, but much of it appears to have collapsed
into the stalagmites around you.  Above you, you can see the dark smoke
which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.  To the
north, a trickle of water breaks through a crack in the wall while to the
south and east, the cavern continues.  The western wall seems unstable,
as though the debris could topple at any moment.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a closed canyon.  At one point in the past, this
place obviously had a ceiling, but much of it appears to have collapsed
into the stalagmites around you.  Above you, you can see the dark smoke
which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.  To the
north, a trickle of water breaks through a crack in the wall while to the
south and west, the cavern continues.  The lichen-covered wall to the 
east looks smooth and unmarred by the collapse.

rooms.name: A Smoldering Valley
rooms.desc:
Ash and patches of yellow moss cover the moist gound here.  All around you,
the haze and smoke of recent volcanic activity make you cover your mouth
to breathe.  To the north, a canyon extends out of the reach of the haze.
To the south and east, the valley floor continues, while to the west, a
solid face of rock impedes your travel.

rooms.name: Smoke and Ash
rooms.desc:
You are standing on unstable, volcanic ground.  To the north, a river of
lava seems to come out of the mountains and flows eastward, cutting off
most of your travelling options.  To the south, a wall of hardened lava
and pumice forms a barrier for the flowing molten rock, forcing it to
travel eastward, away from you.  Ash and smoke spout upward from flares
of fire in the ground.  The ground could give way at any moment.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Vent
rooms.desc:
You are standing before a vent in the volcano.  Rivulets of lava
stream from the hole which seems to lead deep into the mountains.
   Clouds of ash and dust choke you as you avoid the deadly puddles
of molten rock while gusts of superheated air rush from within the
mountain to blast you at the vent.
   You can enter the mountain to the east or return toward the cooler
climes to the west.

rooms.name: A Trodden Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a snowy mountain pass.  Smooth, white snow and ice
blanket the ground in an even layer of rime.  The cliff walls which 
surround you on both the east and west drip with frozen water, forming
slalactites of frigid ice.  To the north, the trail continues to a bend
while to the south, the trail descends down the mountain.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, high
mountain walls and pine branches meet to prevent light and heavy winds
from touching the ground here.  To the north and west, mountain walls
impede your travel while to the south and east, more of the forest
allows easy passage.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, thick pine
branches intertwine to block out much of the mountain sunlight and cast
the forest floor into shadow.  The forest surrounds you on the east, west,
and south, while a mountain cliff blocks any travel to the north.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing amidst a grove of thick pines and shrubs.  Scurrying
animals and birds rustle fallen cones and leaves here, searching for
grubs and other edibles.  To your north, south, and west, the forest
continues, while to the east, a mountain lake appears, catching the 
water runoff from the peaks to the southeast.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Lake
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the surface of Sulfur Fur Lake.  The cold, clear
waters from the the mountains around you have drained off to create this
body of water.  Below you, down in the depths of the lake, you can see
piles of pale yellow stones.  The lake continues to the east, while dry
land rests to the north and west.  To the south, a waterfall drops out
of the mountain, impeding your progress in that direction.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Lake
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the surface of Sulfur Fur Lake.  The cold, clear
waters from the the mountains around you have drained off to create this
body of water.  Below you, down in the depths of the lake, you can see
masses of pale yellow rocks.  The lake continues to the west, while dry
land can be seen to the north.  To the south and west, tall mountain
walls form the edges of the lake.

rooms.name: A Canyon Floor
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of an ash-filled canyon.  Smooth yellow
cliff walls rise high to the east and west, forming a smooth north-
south path.  To the north, the canyon seems to stretch forever, while to
the south, the canyon seems to open into a smoldering valley.  The heat
is almost desert-like in that direction, though the ash seems to thin
out, allowing easier travel.

rooms.name: The Bend in the Trail
rooms.desc:
Here, it appears that someone has been trying to remove signs of travel.
Pine branches have been used to smooth over footprints in the snow, 
leaving evergreen branches and needles across its too-smooth surface.
The cliff walls bend sharply here, forming an impassible wall to the
north and west.  To the east, a well-trodden path exposes a rocky ground
while to the south, the trail proceeds between the cliff faces, down the 
mountain.

rooms.name: The Antali Gate
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a cul-de-sac.  Tall, ice-covered cliffs block your
progress to the south and east, while an enormous iron gate stands closed
to the north, built into the cliff itself.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, high
mountain walls and pine branches meet to prevent light and heavy winds
from touching the ground here.  To the north and west, mountain walls
impede your travel while to the south and east, more of the forest
allows easy passage.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, high
mountain walls and pine branches meet to prevent light and heavy winds
from touching the ground here.  To the north and west, mountain walls
impede your travel while to the south and east, more of the forest
allows easy passage.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, high
mountain walls and pine branches meet to prevent light and heavy winds
from touching the ground here.  To the north, mountain walls impede
your travel while to the east and west, more of the forest allows easy
passage.  To the south, you spot a large body of water.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees at the exit of the forest.
To the north, a mountain valley opens between two enormous cliff walls,
while to the east, a solid face of rock impedes your progress.  To the
south, you see a lake which seems to extend back to the southwest and the
forest.

rooms.name: A Canyon Floor
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of an ash-filled canyon.  Smooth yellow
cliff walls rise high to the east and west, forming a smooth north-
south path.  To the north and south, the canyon seems to stretch
forever.  You feel tired as you plow your way through knee-high 
sulfurous ash.

rooms.name: An Antali Home
rooms.desc:
This stone and mortar dwelling serves as a small fortress against the
cold and the driving winds that tend to ravage the village.  Skins of
snow leopards and tigers almost completely cover the cold stone floor
of this one-room house whose walls display the trophies of those whose
skins blanket the floor.  A lone hearth stands against the western wall,
its fire within cracking cheerfully.

rooms.name: An Antali Village
rooms.desc:
You stand just inside the gate of an Antali village.  These northmen
seem to have fortified a small settlement among the peaks and cliffs 
and forged a tight bond of unity.  The village appears to be small
with shops and guardhouses lining the main street which seems to end
at some sort of ceremonial temple.  To the north, the street continues
while to either side of you, buildings stand solidly against the cold.
To the south, you see the exit from the village.

rooms.name: An Antali Home
rooms.desc:
This stone and mortar stronghouse serves as resistance against the
cold and driving winds that tend to ravage the village.  Skins of
snow leopards and tigers almost completely cover the cold stone floor
of this house whose walls boast the heads of those beasts whose skins
blanket the floor.  A lone hearth stands against the eastern wall, 
stone cold.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bend of a mountain valley.  To the west and 
south, solid walls of rock impede your progress, while to the east
and north, the valley continues to wind among the peaks.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing between two high mountain cliffs.  To the north and south,
solid walls of rock impede your progress, while to the east and west, the
valley continues, leading you higher into the peaks.  You can see a few
prints here in the snow.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing between two high mountain cliffs.  To the north and east,
solid walls of rock impede your progress, while to the west, the mountain
valley continues, leading you higher into the peaks.  To the south, tall
trees form the beginning of a forest.

rooms.name: A Canyon Floor
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of an ash-filled canyon.  Smooth yellow
cliff walls rise high to the east and west, forming a smooth north-
south path.  To the north and south, the canyon seems to stretch
forever.  You feel tired as you plow your way through knee-high 
sulfurous ash.

rooms.name: An Antali Shoppe
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a stone fortification.  Thick, solid stone walls
shelter you from the blasting winds outside as well as protect the 
goods within.  Around you, thick skins and stone hunting weapons line
the floor and walls, indicating that the inhabitants of this village
care only about survival, not conquest.

rooms.name: An Antali Village Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the main streeth of the Antali village.  Shops and
guardhouses line this street which ends further to the north at some
sort of religious establishment.  To the south, you can see the entrance
to the village.

rooms.name: An Antali Guardhouse
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a massive stone fortification.  High walls of dark
stone surround you.  Several Antali guards are here, talking quietly and
stoking the hearth which rests in the southern wall.  The walls and floors
are spartan, as though the guards need only the chairs and the tables
they converse at to fulfill their duties.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bend of a mountain valley.  To the west and
north, solid walls of rock impede your progress, while to the east
and south, the valley continues to wind among the peaks.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing between two high mountain cliffs.  To the north and south,
solid walls of rock impede your progress, while to the east and west, the
valley continues, leading you higher into the peaks.  A single jawbone of
some animal is here, sticking out of the ground.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing between two high mountain cliffs.  To the south and east,
solid walls of ice-covered rock impede your progress, while to the west and
north, the valley continues.

rooms.name: A Canyon Floor
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of an ash-filled canyon.  Smooth yellow
cliff walls rise high to the east and west, forming a smooth north-
south path.  To the north, you see a trail bend sharply up a mountain
as it breaks away from the canyon while to the south, the canyon seems
to continue forever.

rooms.name: The Tower
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the base of a locked tower.  A circular staircase
ascends to a locked and barred door just above you.  Around you, a few
pieces of wood and debris litter the floor as though no one has visited
this place recently to clean it.

rooms.name: An Antali Village Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the main streeth of the Antali village. A tower and
some homes line this street which ends here at an enormous temple.  To 
the south, the street continues back toward the entrance to the village.

rooms.name: An Antali Home
rooms.desc:
This stone and mortar stronghouse serves as resistance against the
cold and driving winds that tend to ravage the village.  Skins of
snow leopards and tigers almost completely cover the cold stone floor
of this house whose walls boast the heads of those beasts whose skins
blanket the floor.  A lone hearth stands against the eastern wall, 
stone cold.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
You are on a snowy mountain path that winds its way northward into the
peaks above.  Here and there, enormous clawmarks mar the exposed stone
of the cliff walls, as though they had been scratches by an enormous
beast who wished to keep its claws in prime condition.  To the west,
the trail continues into the mountains, while to the north, the trail
winds its way through snow and ice as it climbs higher into the peaks.
Everywhere else, ice-covered stone walls prevent your progress.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
You are on a snowy mountain path that winds its way northward into the
peaks above.  Here and there, enormous clawmarks mar the exposed stone
of the cliff walls, as though they had been scratches by an enormous
beast who wished to keep its claws in prime condition.  To the west, 
the trail continues into the mountains, while to the east, the trail
meets a junction of other paths.

rooms.name: A Mountain Junction
rooms.desc:
Snow is really beginning to pile up here in drifts.  To the west, the
mountain valley ascends to a plateau before narrowing into a simple
mountain trail.  To the south, the valley descends down the mountain.
Strangely enough, the mountain wall to the west has a crevasse in it
which seems to rapidly descend down a slope.  The scent of sulfur is
strong and you can see yellowish moss on the mountain wall by the
crevasse.

rooms.name: The Base of the Cliff
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of a steep cliff.  A climbable trail curves
up the cliff face to the west to an opening in the cliff.  All around you,
sulfurous moss grows on pale trees and shrubs.  You feel very, very warm,
and the ash on the ground indicates some volcanic activity nearby.  An
outcropping of rocks, perhaps the face of a new mountain, blocks the way
to the east, while clear trails run north and south from here.

rooms.name: Snow Mage's Sanctuary
rooms.desc:
Skulls and bones litter the floor around you as you step through the
cluttered room of parchment and skins.  An enormous cot rests against
the northwestern corner, providing a comfortable resting place for
the holy mage of the tribe.
To the north lies a door made of ice -- you guess it to be at least
three feet thick.

rooms.name: The Mead Hall
rooms.desc:
You are standing in both the cultural and religious center of the village.
Here, ceremonies and rites of passage are conducted as are feasts and
other village functions.  On the floor, an enormous glyph rests, painted
in red, the symbol of snow magic.  Similarly, a matching symbol appears
on the door to the east and above the steel door to the west, which appears
to lead outside.

rooms.name: The Training Yard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a pile of snow.  Here, outside the Mead Hall, young
warriors practice their skills on animated snowmen with wooden weapons.
Occasionally, you see the scurrying of an enchanted snow rabbit which is
a common target for young Antali archers.  Around you, three stout cliffs
wall you inside the training yard.  The only exit lies back to the west.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
You are on a snowy mountain path that winds its way northward into the
peaks above.  Here and there, enormous clawmarks mar the exposed stone
of the cliff walls, as though they had been scratches by an enormous
beast who wished to keep its claws in prime condition.  To the west,
the trail continues into the mountains, while to the south, the trail
winds its way through snow and ice as it descends the peaks into the
valley below.  Everywhere else, ice-covered stone walls prevent your
progress.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
You are on a snowy mountain path that winds its way northward into the
peaks above.  Here and there, enormous claw and tooth marks blemish the
exposed stone of the cliff walls.  There is a strong scent of decay 
here which seems to come from the north, over the mountain wall.  To the
west, the trail continues down the mountain while to the east, it bends
northward around the next peak.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
Deep snow makes this part of the trail almost impassible.  All around you,
tall white mountains and ice blanket the terrain in a frozen sheet.  To
the north, the trail continues to the peaks while to the west, the trail
begins to slope gently back down the mountains.  All other directions are
blocked by ice.

rooms.name: A Sulfurous Canyon
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the middle of a canyon.  To both your east and west,
tall, even walls block your progress as bits of ash and dust rain down
upon you.  The Sulfur Fur, the yellow moss on the canyon walls, seems
to glow a bit as the ash falls upon it.  To the north, the canyon bends,
while to the south, the canyon opens into a broad field of trees and
shrubs.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Lair
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the lair of a white dragon.  You can see little
that is different from the outside chamber, save the scattering of 
coins on the cavern floor and the enormous piles of snow all around
you.  The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: A Mountain Lair
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the lair of an enormous beast.  Crushed stalactites and
stalagmites litter the floor and bases of the cavern walls.  Further to the
west, you can make out something white and glittering, as though a vast
chandelier was hanging from the chamber ceiling and refracting the light.
To the east, the cavern continues toward the exit, while to the north and
south, solid cave walls block your progress.

rooms.name: A Mountain Cavern
rooms.desc:
The cavern seems to be getting cooler as you travel to the west.  Pools
of frozen water tell you that the air is below freezing.  Solid walls and
stalagmites impede your travel to the north and south, though you can
travel westward, deeper into the cave or eastward, toward the cave exit.

rooms.name: A Mountain Cavern
rooms.desc:
The cavern seems to be getting cooler as you travel to the west, though
pools of water on the floor tell you that it is not quite freezing.  
Solid walls and thick stalagmites impede your travel to the north and south,
though you can travel westward, deeper into the cave or eastward, toward
the entrance.

rooms.name: A Mountain Cave
rooms.desc:
The frigid winds of the mountains outside are absent here among the
stalactites of ice and stone.  Around you, bones and scraps of fur
litter the cavern floor.  There are solid walls to both the north and
south, impeding progress in those directions.  To the west, the cave
leads deeper into the mountain, while back to the east, the cave entrance
is becoming covered with snow.

rooms.name: A Mountain Peak
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the top of a tall mountain.  Strong winds and sleet
pelt your face and hands as you strain your eyes to examine your surroundings.
To the north and east, snowdrifts impede your progress.  To the south, the
trail continues down the mountain.  There seems to be a hole in the snow
to the west.  Its angle suggests that it slopes down, into the mountain.

rooms.name: A Canyon Bend
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bend of a canyon.  To the north and west, tall
canyon walls impede your progress while to the south and east, the
canyon continues under the rain of ash and dust.

rooms.name: A Canyon Bend
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bend of a canyon.  To the north, south, and east,
tall canyon walls impede your progress while to the west, the canyon
continues under the rain of ash and dust.  There appears to be some sort
of crevasse in the wall to the south, but debris and the sheer narrowness
of the opening make searching it futile.

rooms.name: In Space
rooms.desc:
You step through the door and into inky blackness. The doorway behind you
is gone, and to the north is the only way your body is allowed to move.
